Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a realistic, production-quality UI concept for a personal Navidrome music frontend. One independent finished desktop application screenshot only, exact target canvas 1440 x 1024. This is an exploration image, not a built app. Fill the natural viewport with the interface. No device, browser chrome, presentation frame, surrounding desktop, options collage, watermark, external concept title or numbered label.
Audience: the owner listening to their own music collection. Current date anchor 15 October 2026; avoid date-dependent content. UI in Dutch. Small product wordmark "navidrome". This is a new original visual direction; the attached Mobbin screenshot(s) are reference images ONLY for music interaction anatomy and hierarchy. Do not copy their branding, artwork, exact composition, commercial navigation, device chrome or watermark.
Design a focused primary screen: one clear main task and at most two supporting areas. Use space, alignment, typography and subtle row separators before cards. No card-inside-card nesting, ornamental dashboard statistics, subscription offers, podcasts, public charts, AI recommendations, decorative graphs, invented server controls or Connect/casting/offline promises. Use actual-looking original generated album art, crisp line icons and purposeful spacing, no emoji or blank placeholder tiles. UI text baseline 14-16px at target canvas, small metadata still legible, high contrast and useful generous targets. At most two font families. No clipped controls, illegible microcopy, overlapping panels or truncated main heading.
Fictional common library: album "Slow Light", artist "Mara Vale", 2024, Indie, six tracks totaling 26:21: First Light 4:10; Window Seat 4:32; After Rain 5:06; Paper Skies 3:48; Low Sun 4:04; Still Here 4:41. Main cover is an original analog photograph of warm sunlight and a geometric window shadow on a textured ochre wall, no cover lettering. Supporting albums when needed: "Blue Hours" by Luca North with deep blue ocean artwork; "Field Notes" by Meridian Trio with an abstract earthy print; "Soft Static" by Onda with misty monochrome photography; "Northbound" by Ellis Reed with a forest photograph; "Quiet Signals" by June Atlas with an orange-red abstract image.
Currently playing in every screenshot: "Window Seat" by "Mara Vale", album "Slow Light", elapsed 2:14 of 4:32. Show pause icon because playing, progress around halfway, previous and next, volume and access to queue; use one player, not two duplicate playback systems. Do not label the source FLAC as a guarantee of lossless browser output. Playback and selection highlights must be coherent.
Useful Dutch labels where appropriate: "Bibliotheek", "Albums", "Artiesten", "Nummers", "Playlists", "Favorieten", "Zoek in je muziek", "Afspelen", "Shuffle", "Hierna", "Wachtrij", "Speel hierna", "Voeg toe aan wachtrij". Omit labels not needed for the chosen screen. Finish with meticulous professional alignment and refined typography.

concepts.title: Platenkamer
concepts.brief: Direction: a warm editorial listening library, focused ALBUM DETAIL. Calm ivory #f4f0e6 base, near-black ink, brick-red #a6422c accent. Distinctive literary serif headline resembling Fraunces paired with precise humanist sans-serif UI. Horizontal navigation at top with small navidrome left, Bibliotheek / Playlists / Favorieten, search at right; no permanent left sidebar. Page has a restrained breadcrumb Bibliotheek / Albums. Strong asymmetric editorial composition with 340px square Slow Light cover on the left and large 68px serif title Slow Light beside it, Mara Vale and sparse album metadata. Clear brick-red Afspelen action and secondary heart/overflow only. Below the title area a spacious six-track album list aligned to a strong grid with understated separators and current Window Seat visibly playing, no large bordered container. Let artwork and typography carry the identity, like a carefully typeset independent record-store catalogue. Persistent ivory footer player across width with small current artwork/title left and clear controls center. A small quiet next-track affordance at right. No record-player hardware illustration, skeuomorphic vinyl disc or lifestyle room. The product itself must feel useful, not like a marketing website. Beautiful whitespace while fully fitting all six tracks and player.

concepts.title: Nachtdienst
concepts.brief: Direction: an immersive, cinematic dark LISTENING view. Nearly black warm charcoal #141311 base with subtle warm brown artwork-derived atmosphere; ivory text, restrained amber focus. Narrow 76px left navigation rail and small readable search top; active listening icon indicated. Main composition: one beautiful 470px square Slow Light cover on left, anchored with track Window Seat and artist Mara Vale below. Right half dedicated to large spacious lyric typography, not a list of many panels. Display only these ORIGINAL fictional lyric lines: "Morning gathers on the windows" / "We leave our shadows by the door" / "Let the quiet carry us home". Center line is active and bright ivory; other lines readable muted gray, not invisible. A small heading "Songtekst". Lyrics are a hypothetical server-available state. Below lyrics show a compact Hierna section with only First Light and After Rain, unobtrusive thumbnail and duration. One low fixed player strip contains elegant progress, 2:14 / 4:32, main pause, previous/next and volume; all text controls readable. Premium music-listening focus rather than a dashboard. No fake audio waveform or visualizer. No giant gradient orb; atmospheric tint must derive gently from album artwork. Use a confident modern sans-serif like Söhne/Inter, considered whitespace, restrained hairlines. No album grids, no extra widgets. This must look visually and structurally distinct from an album page or standard Spotify clone.

concepts.title: Index
concepts.brief: Direction: a precise information-rich LIBRARY browser, inspired by a thoughtfully designed native desktop catalogue rather than a streaming homepage. Crisp white #fafbfc and cool #eef1f4 surfaces, deep slate text, cobalt-blue #255ee8 active accents. IBM Plex Sans style interface, subtle monospaced durations only. Top toolbar has small navidrome wordmark left and a prominent global search field with "Zoek in je muziek" and subtle Ctrl K shortcut hint. Below, one contiguous three-column workspace divided by simple hairlines, not floating cards: narrow 210px artist column titled Artiesten with 9 names and Mara Vale selected in pale blue; middle 270px albums column showing 4 restrained album rows with 56px art and Slow Light selected; broad right track pane with header Slow Light, Mara Vale, modest 84px art, play and heart actions. Right pane shows the six album tracks in a proper legible aligned table, columns Titel, Artiest, Duur; consistent row height around 52px and current Window Seat highlighted with blue active marker and pause/equalizer icon. Avoid pretending a search has matching counts; this is a browse state. Bottom persistent player, light surface with controls and queue access, same current song and time. A simple compact global navigation row Bibliotheek / Playlists / Favorieten remains clear. The design should feel fast, calm, exact and keyboard friendly. Preserve useful whitespace below the six rows rather than filling with invented analytics. No web-admin look, data charts or KPI counts. This is the most compact and functional direction, clearly different in information hierarchy from the others.

concepts.title: Mixtape
concepts.brief: Direction: a bold, expressive PLAYLIST and queue workspace, with graphic independent-music energy. Deep aubergine #2d1730 base, warm parchment text, vivid coral #ff765d primary action, pale blush queue panel. Confident condensed grotesk display heading resembling Archivo SemiCondensed, readable sans-serif for controls. Left 190px sidebar lists Bibliotheek, Favorieten and a short Playlists section with "Voor onderweg" selected and two other playlists. Center pane is one cohesive surface. Upper header has a 136px original abstract coral album-like playlist cover, small "PLAYLIST", a bold 60px heading "Voor onderweg", and "12 nummers". Main action is a coral play control and adjacent Shuffle and overflow, not excessive badges. Show 7 visible track rows from fictional library with tiny artwork, title, artist and duration. Window Seat currently playing. Right 300px blush queue panel is an integral split surface, not a floating overlay; title Wachtrij, small current track at top, separator then Hierna with 4 ordered rows and clear reorder grips. Include discrete "Bewaar als playlist" control. This illustrates how listening order can be composed with current track separate from next tracks. One clear action state: a single row overflow context menu open offering "Speel hierna" and "Voeg toe aan wachtrij", anchored without obscuring main content or current playback. Omit if it makes the frame busy. Bottom full-width aubergine player cleanly aligned. Design should feel vibrant and personal, not neon gamer UI and not colorful dashboard tiles. Keep excellent readability and avoid cyan-purple gradients. Strong hierarchy with only playlist list and queue as supporting content.

concepts.title: Panorama
concepts.brief: Direction: a spacious, visually led ALBUM GALLERY for browsing a personal record collection. Contemporary Swiss gallery aesthetic: very pale sage #e9eee8 canvas, deep forest #193d32 type, quiet green #46765c accents, crisp neutral sans-serif resembling Manrope with restrained weight changes. No serif headline, no conventional permanent sidebar. A top header with small navidrome mark at far left, Bibliotheek / Playlists / Favorieten inline, search field at right. Below a strong but not oversized "Albums" heading at left, a small Albums / Artiesten / Nummers view switch, one concise genre dropdown and sort "Recent toegevoegd". Main area features a beautifully spaced gallery of SIX square original album covers in three columns and two rows, each approximately 240px square with title and artist below. Covers are the main visual attraction: Slow Light, Blue Hours, Field Notes, Soft Static, Northbound, Quiet Signals. Frame allows two complete rows without clipping; selected/playing Slow Light has subtle green playing indicator, not a heavy selection border. No extra editorial hero, recommendation cards, stats or paragraph copy. Below gallery a restrained low player dock on same page surface with a thin divider, current small cover/title left, central previous/pause/next and progress, volume and queue control right. It may be horizontally inset but do not wrap the entire app inside a centered card. Balanced gallery spacing and quiet typography make this feel like an art catalogue for everyday listening. Distinct from the warm album-detail direction: cool sage, sans-serif, cover-first grid, minimal metadata, wide open layout.
